title: Tom Lee calls Ethereum’s 4% post-hack fall bullish
summary: Tom Lee believes crypto's muted reaction to Binance's $6.3 billion hack is another sign that a bull market is underway. The BitMine chairman pointed to Ethereum's roughly 4% decline following the Oct. 29 theft, which was more than four times larger than the $1.5 billion stolen from Bybit in February 2025.
